jp: 才能はあるのに修行を嫌がって何度も家出するもんだから、わざわざ死亡工作までして忍を抜けさせてやったというのに。まさか遊びながら我流で俺より強くなってしまうとはな…。お兄ちゃんは泣きたいぞ。立つ瀬がないぞ。
jp_grezzo: "才能はあるのに修行を嫌がって何度も家出するもんだから、わざわざ死亡工作までして忍を抜けさせてやったというのに。まさか遊びながら我流で俺より強くなってしまうとはな…。お兄ちゃんは泣きたいぞ。立つ瀬がないぞ。"
en: My little sister was very talented, but she didn't want to train and kept running away from home. I even went to the trouble of faking her death so that she could leave the Shinobi world. Yet, I never imagined that she would eventually become stronger than me just from playing around. She even developed her own unique style of Ninjutsu... Some big brother I turned out to be.
en_grezzo: "My little sister was very talented, but she didn't want to train and kept running away from home. I even went to the trouble of faking her death so that she could leave the Shinobi world. Yet, I never imagined that she would eventually become stronger than me just from playing around. She even developed her own unique style of Ninjutsu... Some big brother I turned out to be."
it: Mia sorella aveva un gran talento, ma l'addestramento le stava stretto e scappava di casa in continuazione. Le ho perfino inscenato la morte, per farla uscire dal mondo shinobi. E invece, a furia di giocare, è diventata più forte di me e si è inventata un ninjutsu tutto suo... Bel fratello maggiore che sono.

jp: …まぁ。反抗期の酷かった妹が、こうして俺を頼ってくれたのはすごく嬉しいがな！お兄ちゃん頑張っちゃうぞ。
jp_grezzo: "…まぁ。反抗期の酷かった妹が、こうして俺を頼ってくれたのはすごく嬉しいがな！お兄ちゃん頑張っちゃうぞ。"
en: ...Well, at least my sister, who was once that rebellious little kid, has come to rely on me like this! I'm so happy! As her older brother, I'm going to do my best.
en_grezzo: "...Well, at least my sister, who was once that rebellious little kid, has come to rely on me like this! I'm so happy! As her older brother, I'm going to do my best."
it: ...Be', però. Quella mia sorella che nell'età ribelle era un flagello, adesso si affida a me! Sono felicissimo! E allora il fratello maggiore ci si mette d'impegno.

jp: 表向きは、ファッションやおしゃべりを嗜む普通の女の子。しかし裏では、闇に紛れて人々のために忍術を振るう…。くぅ～！これだよこれ！僕の理想のニンジャ・ライフスタイルは！
jp_grezzo: "表向きは、ファッションやおしゃべりを嗜む普通の女の子。しかし裏では、闇に紛れて人々のために忍術を振るう…。くぅ～！これだよこれ！僕の理想のニンジャ・ライフスタイルは！"
en: On the surface, she is a normal girl who enjoys fashion and talking. But behind the scenes, she blends in with the darkness and wields her ninjutsu for the people... Oh, no! This is it! This is my ideal Ninja Lifestyle!
en_grezzo: "On the surface, she is a normal girl who enjoys fashion and talking. But behind the scenes, she blends in with the darkness and wields her ninjutsu for the people... Oh, no! This is it! This is my ideal Ninja Lifestyle!"
it: Di giorno, una ragazza qualunque che ama la moda e le chiacchiere. Di notte si confonde col buio e usa il ninjutsu per la gente... Aaah! È questo, è proprio questo! Il mio ideale di vita da ninja!

jp: あれれ…君もここに来てたの？そうか、冒険者だもんね。
jp_grezzo: "あれれ…君もここに来てたの？そうか、冒険者だもんね。"
en: Oh... You're here, too? That's right, you're one of those adventurer types.
en_grezzo: "Oh... You're here, too? That's right, you're one of those adventurer types."
it: Ma guarda... ci sei anche tu? Ah, già, vai all'avventura.

jp: その節はありがとう。いつか、こっちから話しかけてお礼言わなきゃとは思ってたんだけど…。ほら、人前だと市民として振る舞わなきゃいけないからさ。
jp_grezzo: "その節はありがとう。いつか、こっちから話しかけてお礼言わなきゃとは思ってたんだけど…。ほら、人前だと市民として振る舞わなきゃいけないからさ。"
en: Thanks for all that. I was thinking that I should reach out to you sometime and thank you... It's like, when I'm in public, I have to act like a proper citizen for once.
en_grezzo: "Thanks for all that. I was thinking that I should reach out to you sometime and thank you... It's like, when I'm in public, I have to act like a proper citizen for once."
it: Grazie di allora. Volevo venire io a ringraziarti, prima o poi... Sai com'è, in mezzo alla gente mi tocca fare la cittadina per bene.

jp: 実家の流派はあの時やめたんだけど、今はなんかいろいろ物騒だからさ。我流忍術で混沌と戦ってるんだ！我流は良いよ。どんな格好しても、規律だのなんだのと怒られないし最高だよ！
jp_grezzo: "実家の流派はあの時やめたんだけど、今はなんかいろいろ物騒だからさ。我流忍術で混沌と戦ってるんだ！我流は良いよ。どんな格好しても、規律だのなんだのと怒られないし最高だよ！"
en: I quit my family's school back then, but now things are getting a bit hectic. I'm fighting the baddies of Chaos with my own style of ninjutsu! Developing my own style is the best. And no matter how I dress, I don't get yelled at for breaking the rules or anything! This is awesome!
en_grezzo: "I quit my family's school back then, but now things are getting a bit hectic. I'm fighting the baddies of Chaos with my own style of ninjutsu! Developing my own style is the best. And no matter how I dress, I don't get yelled at for breaking the rules or anything! This is awesome!"
it: La scuola di famiglia l'ho lasciata quella volta, ma adesso in giro se ne vedono di tutti i colori. Combatto il caos con un ninjutsu tutto mio! Ed è bellissimo: comunque mi vesta, nessuno viene a farmi la predica sulla disciplina. Il massimo!

jp: えーと…どちらさま？
jp_grezzo: "えーと…どちらさま？"
en: Umm... Who are you?
en_grezzo: "Umm... Who are you?"
it: Ehm... e tu chi saresti?

jp: クエスト必要名声：40000
jp_grezzo: "クエスト必要名声：40000　"
en: Required Fame: 40000
en_grezzo: "Required Fame: 40000 "
it: Fama richiesta: 40000

jp: ふーん…君、強そうだね。君になら頼めるかも。
jp_grezzo: "ふーん…君、強そうだね。君になら頼めるかも。"
en: Hmm... You're strong, aren't you? You might be able to help me out.
en_grezzo: "Hmm... You're strong, aren't you? You might be able to help me out."
it: Uhm... tu sì che sembri in gamba. Forse posso chiederlo a te.

jp: 御意
jp_grezzo: "御意"
en: With pleasure.
en_grezzo: "With pleasure."
it: Come comandate

jp: 無理でござる
jp_grezzo: "無理でござる"
en: Impossible.
en_grezzo: "Impossible."
it: Non è cosa

jp: 僕の兄さん、忍者軍団の頭領やってるんだけどさ。もう融通がきかないのなんのって！僕が忍者やめたいっていくら言っても、機密がどうのこうのの一点張りなんだ…。もうあんな頑固者、兄だとも思わない！ちょっとうちの忍者軍団ごとぶっとばしてきてよ！
jp_grezzo: "僕の兄さん、忍者軍団の頭領やってるんだけどさ。もう融通がきかないのなんのって！僕が忍者やめたいっていくら言っても、機密がどうのこうのの一点張りなんだ…。もうあんな頑固者、兄だとも思わない！ちょっとうちの忍者軍団ごとぶっとばしてきてよ！"
en: My older brother is the head of a group of ninjas. But he's so stuck on tradition! I stopped telling him that I don't want to be a ninja, but it's still true... I can't deal with that stubborn brother of mine anymore! Please get rid of the group of ninjas!
en_grezzo: "My older brother is the head of a group of ninjas. But he's so stuck on tradition! I stopped telling him that I don't want to be a ninja, but it's still true... I can't deal with that stubborn brother of mine anymore! Please get rid of the group of ninjas!"
it: Mio fratello maggiore comanda una banda di ninja, e non c'è verso di farlo ragionare! Gli ho detto mille volte che voglio smettere, e lui giù con la storia dei segreti... Un testardo simile non lo considero più un fratello! Va' a spazzarla via tu, quella banda!

jp: そんなこと言われても困るでござる。
jp_grezzo: "そんなこと言われても困るでござる。"
en: That's a troubling thing to hear.
en_grezzo: "That's a troubling thing to hear."
it: Cotesta risposta mi mette in imbarazzo.

jp: やったぁ！準備ができたら僕に声をかけてね。屋敷まで案内するからさ。
jp_grezzo: "やったぁ！準備ができたら僕に声をかけてね。屋敷まで案内するからさ。"
en: Alright! Just let me know when you're ready. I'll take you to them.
en_grezzo: "Alright! Just let me know when you're ready. I'll take you to them."
it: Evviva! Fammi un cenno quando è il momento: ti accompagno io alla tenuta.

jp: 目をつぶる
jp_grezzo: "目をつぶる"
en: (Cover your eyes)
en_grezzo: "(Cover your eyes)"
it: (Chiudere gli occhi)

jp: 何をする気だ！
jp_grezzo: "何をする気だ！"
en: What are you trying to pull?!
en_grezzo: "What are you trying to pull?!"
it: Che cosa hai in mente?!

jp: 準備はできた？案内するからちょっと目をつぶっててね…。
jp_grezzo: "準備はできた？案内するからちょっと目をつぶっててね…。"
en: Have you made your preparations? I'll need you to cover your eyes while I guide you...
en_grezzo: "Have you made your preparations? I'll need you to cover your eyes while I guide you..."
it: Tutto pronto? Ti accompagno io, ma tieni gli occhi chiusi un momento...

jp: 何って…案内するだけだよ！？
jp_grezzo: "何って…案内するだけだよ！？"
en: Wha... I'm just going to guide you there, okay?!
en_grezzo: "Wha... I'm just going to guide you there, okay?!"
it: Ma cosa... ti accompagno e basta, ecco!

jp: うん、兄さんを倒すなんて君はやっぱり強いや。僕の目に狂いはなかったみたいだね。
jp_grezzo: "うん、兄さんを倒すなんて君はやっぱり強いや。僕の目に狂いはなかったみたいだね。"
en: Yep, it looks like my eyes didn't deceive me. You're pretty strong if you were able to beat my brother.
en_grezzo: "Yep, it looks like my eyes didn't deceive me. You're pretty strong if you were able to beat my brother."
it: Già, hai battuto mio fratello: sei davvero in gamba. Non mi ero sbagliata sul tuo conto.

jp: えへへ♪ともかく、これで僕もやっと忍者をやめることができるよ。僕、実は可愛い服とか着て街を堂々と歩いてみたかったんだ。何にも縛られず自由きままに…。君が戻ったら似合うかどうか見てもらおうと、アクセサリも買ってあったりして。
jp_grezzo: "えへへ♪ともかく、これで僕もやっと忍者をやめることができるよ。僕、実は可愛い服とか着て街を堂々と歩いてみたかったんだ。何にも縛られず自由きままに…。君が戻ったら似合うかどうか見てもらおうと、アクセサリも買ってあったりして。"
en: Ehehe~ Now I can stop being a ninja. To be honest, I wanted to be able to freely walk around wearing cute clothes. It's nice not being tied down by anything... When you come back, you can tell me whether the accessories I bought look good or not.
en_grezzo: "Ehehe~ Now I can stop being a ninja. To be honest, I wanted to be able to freely walk around wearing cute clothes. It's nice not being tied down by anything... When you come back, you can tell me whether the accessories I bought look good or not."
it: Ehehe... Comunque adesso posso finalmente smettere di fare la ninja. A dirla tutta il mio sogno era girare per le strade con dei vestiti carini, senza niente che mi leghi... Ho anche comprato degli accessori: quando torni mi dirai se mi stanno bene.

jp: …ッ！この気配は…！？
jp_grezzo: "…ッ！この気配は…！？"
en: ...! This presence...?!
en_grezzo: "...! This presence...?!"
it: ...! Questa presenza...?!
